name: Tang ping (躺平)
blurb: Chinese slang for "lying flat": opting out of the rat race and living with low desires
title: Tang Ping (躺平) Meaning: Chinese Slang for Lying Flat
description: Tang ping (躺平), "lying flat", means opting out of overwork and endless competition to live on low desires. A Chinese buzzword of 2021.
h1: What does tang ping (躺平) mean?
answer: Tang ping (躺平, tǎng píng) means "lying flat": stepping out of endless competition, lowering expectations for career, income and spending, and living a simple, low-effort, low-desire life. It is often seen as a reaction to neijuan (involution). The term took off after an April 2021 online post titled "Lying flat is justice" (躺平即是正义), and that year it made both 咬文嚼字's top 10 buzzwords and the National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center's top 10 internet terms.

body: In April 2021 a user posted an essay titled "Lying flat is justice" on the forum Baidu Tieba, describing a life without a house, a high salary or much spending. Reposted to Weibo and Douban, it set off a huge debate, and 躺平 quickly became one of the year's defining words.
The language magazine 咬文嚼字 ranked 躺平 ninth on its 2021 top 10 buzzwords, and the National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center also listed it among the top 10 internet terms of 2021.

ul: 升职太难了，我决定躺平，按时下班 (promotion is too hard; I'm lying flat and leaving on time)
房价太高，买房这件事我先躺平了 (prices are too high; I've given up on buying a flat for now)
这次期末我是躺平了，及格就行 (I'm lying flat for finals; a pass is enough)
说是躺平，其实只是不想再加班 (I say "lying flat", but I just don't want more overtime)
躺平失败，又被领导拉起来干活 (lying flat failed; my boss dragged me back to work)

body: It can describe a whole life philosophy or just one goal: 这件事我躺平了 means "I've stopped fighting for this".

body: Most people say 躺平 half-jokingly to vent stress; they are not literally doing nothing. Many commentators also criticise it as too passive, and 咬文嚼字's own entry urged young people to face competition and pressure positively.
In a job interview, saying you want to "lie flat" will sound unmotivated; "I want a better work-life balance" is safer.

faq.q: Is tang ping the same as quiet quitting?
faq.a: They overlap. Quiet quitting is about doing only your job's minimum; tang ping is broader, a low-desire attitude toward work, housing and consumption.
It is neutral to slightly negative. Said about yourself it is usually self-mocking; said about someone else it can be a criticism.

faq.q: How is tang ping related to neijuan?
faq.a: Neijuan is the ever-harder, pointless competition; tang ping is choosing not to take part. The two words are usually discussed together.
